notes.title: new 1.0 version
notes.notes:
1、remake of whole game, all level can be played, all characters's basic skill and frame event's function's finished, ruiya and shanley's skill configed.

2.all soldier level can be played well.

3.fix lots of bugs.

later update plan:
0.listen to player's option and advice then make the game better.
1.make video,tutorials, information of combo, community feedback
2.remake flying level
3.balance data tweak, make 3 difficulty type(current version is normal),star system and level finished bonus. 
4.endless mode(arena mode)
5.one point hp mode.
